faq_heading: Homes near Grandview Heights Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Grandview Heights Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Grandview Heights Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Grandview Heights Secondary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Grandview Heights Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 272 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,800,000, townhomes $825,000, condos $489,900. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Grandview Heights Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Grandview Heights Secondary the median was 28 days on the market, closing at 97.3% of the list price, with 4% of sales above the list price for the 272 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Grandview Heights Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Pacific Heights Elementary (0.3 km north-east), Edgewood Elementary (0.8 km south-west) and Southridge School (2.0 km west).

Grandview Heights Secondary is a secondary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 16987 25 Ave. It teaches grades 8 to 12.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Grandview Heights Secondary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 2 km of the school.
How the Grandview Heights Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Grandview Heights Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Grandview Heights Secondary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 272 homes sold within 2 km of Grandview Heights Secondary: 89 houses, 139 townhomes and 8 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $825,000.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Grandview Heights Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Grandview Heights Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Grandview Heights Secondary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median townhome within 2 km of Grandview Heights Secondary was $825,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
